title: OpenAI CEO on Job Disappearance
full_monologue: **OpenAI's CEO Just Predicted When Jobs Will Disappear**. Sam Altman recently hinted that repetitive, routine jobs could vanish within the next decade. But creative and human-centric roles may thrive. The future of work is evolving fast. Automation is accelerating, but so is innovation. What skills will matter most? Let me know in the comments.
